name: EA_MACD_FixedPSAR
summary: This EA uses MACD crossover signals confirmed by EMA trend direction to open buy/sell positions. It offers three trailing stop modes: none, fixed trailing stop, and a custom Parabolic SAR-inspired trailing stop. Positions are closed either on MACD signal reversal or by trailing stop/take profit/stop loss levels.
summary_zh: 该EA使用MACD交叉信号并结合EMA趋势方向确认来开仓买入或卖出。提供三种追踪止损模式：无追踪、固定追踪止损、以及自定义Parabolic SAR式追踪止损。仓位可通过MACD信号反转、追踪止损、止盈或止损平仓。
strategy_analysis: 该策略基于MACD指标的动量交叉进行交易，入场条件为MACD主线与信号线交叉且MACD值超过开仓阈值，同时EMA趋势方向需确认（买入时EMA上升，卖出时EMA下降）。出场条件包括MACD反向交叉且超过平仓阈值、固定追踪止损和Parabolic SAR式追踪止损三种模式。仓位管理采用固定手数，未启用动态仓位调整。资金管理方面仅在开仓前检查可用保证金，但缺少最大持仓限制和回撤控制。Parabolic SAR追踪止损是该EA的核心亮点，它自行计算SAR值而非调用指标，根据价格新高新低动态调整止损，但重置逻辑存在缺陷——开仓时以开仓价格而非实际高低点初始化追踪最大值，且在价格未创新高时完全不调整止损。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy trades based on MACD momentum crossovers, with entry conditions requiring the MACD main line to cross the signal line while exceeding the open level threshold, confirmed by EMA trend direction (rising EMA for buys, falling EMA for sells). Exit conditions include MACD reverse crossover exceeding the close level threshold, fixed trailing stop, and a custom Parabolic SAR-style trailing stop. Position sizing uses a fixed lot size with no dynamic lot adjustment based on account equity or risk percentage. Money management only checks free margin before opening a position, lacking maximum position limits or drawdown controls. The Parabolic SAR trailing stop is the EA's core feature, computing SAR values internally rather than calling the indicator, dynamically adjusting stops based on new price highs/lows, but the reset logic is flawed—initializing trailing max at the entry price rather than actual price extremes, and failing to adjust the stop when price doesn't make new highs.

parameters.name: InpTrailngMode
parameters.description: 追踪止损模式：无/固定/Parabolic SAR

pros: 内置三种追踪止损模式，Parabolic SAR追踪止损能有效锁定利润
MACD信号结合EMA趋势过滤，避免逆势交易
代码结构清晰，使用MQL5标准交易库，面向对象设计便于维护
包含参数校验逻辑，检查止盈止损是否满足交易所最小距离要求
pros_en: Three trailing stop modes built-in, with Parabolic SAR trailing effectively locking in profits
MACD signals combined with EMA trend filter, avoiding counter-trend trades
Clean code structure using MQL5 standard trade libraries, OOP design for maintainability
Includes parameter validation logic checking if TP/SL meet exchange minimum distance requirements
cons: 固定手数无动态仓位管理，未根据账户风险比例调整手数
Parabolic SAR追踪止损初始化逻辑有缺陷，用开仓价格而非实际高低点初始化
缺少点差过滤，在波动性大的市场或高点差环境下可能产生滑点损失
未检查新K线形成，每个tick都执行逻辑可能导致重复信号
止盈计算未使用NormalizeDouble，可能导致精度问题
cons_en: Fixed lot sizing without dynamic position management, no risk-based lot adjustment
Parabolic SAR trailing stop initialization is flawed, using entry price instead of actual price extremes
No spread filter, potential slippage losses in volatile or high-spread market conditions
No new bar check, logic executes every tick potentially causing duplicate signals
Take profit calculation missing NormalizeDouble, may cause precision issues
improvements: 添加基于账户风险比例的动态仓位计算，替代固定手数
修正Parabolic SAR追踪止损的初始化逻辑，应使用实际价格高低点而非开仓价
添加新K线检测机制，避免在同一根K线上重复执行交易逻辑
增加点差过滤，当点差过大时暂停开仓
improvements_en: Add dynamic position sizing based on account risk percentage instead of fixed lots
Fix Parabolic SAR trailing stop initialization to use actual price highs/lows instead of entry price
Add new bar detection to prevent redundant trade logic execution on the same bar
Add spread filter to pause opening positions when spread is excessively wide

risk_points: Parabolic SAR追踪止损在价格未创新高时不调整止损，可能在横盘行情中无法有效保护利润
缺少新K线检测，可能在同一根K线内重复触发交易逻辑
固定手数在高杠杆账户中可能造成过大风险敞口
止盈计算未归一化可能导致订单被拒绝
risk_points_en: Parabolic SAR trailing stop doesn't adjust when price fails to make new highs, potentially failing to protect profits in sideways markets
No new bar detection may cause duplicate trade logic triggers within the same bar
Fixed lot sizing may create excessive risk exposure on high-leverage accounts
Take profit calculation not normalized may cause order rejection
